frame_racking_rev_j.basis: front and back portals, corner uprights only (mid uprights, cast corner brackets and panels NOT credited: conservative and the same for both); X reaction 27.2 N = head 13.6 kg x 2 m/s^2; mode mass = Y gantry 19.3 kg + 10 kg of upper frame (ASSUMED)

frame_racking_rev_j.pass_rule: bought-plate racking stiffness >= the GUS-1 value
frame_racking_rev_j.note: with GUS-1 radii (20/50) and a smaller 60 x 60 plate (20/40) the racking would fall to 0.74 x: do not substitute a 60 mm plate

y_belt_clamp_rev_j.design: belt end into a 3.0 mm slot, around a D6 hardened dowel (ISO 8734 6 x 20) in a D9 pocket, back on itself tooth-to-tooth; two loops per carriage; slot length = the old YBP clamped length per end (about 20 mm)
y_belt_clamp_rev_j.basis: pretension 40 N (ASSUMED) + Y stall 71 N (0.45 N m / r)
y_belt_clamp_rev_j.bend: D6 pin = 3 mm bend radius at a STATIC end (the GT2 running minimum is 12T, D7.6); glass cord fatigue does not apply to a static end
y_belt_clamp_rev_j.verify: pull test on the 1 m GT2 offcut already on the list before the YC order
y_belt_clamp_rev_j.belt_modes: clamp position and free belt lengths unchanged: Y belt modes 15.2 / 21.5 Hz and X modes unchanged
y_belt_clamp_rev_j.machining: boss from 40 mm stock (YC was 15 mm plate): slots 3.0 wide x 15.0 deep from below (D3 long series, L/D 5), D9 pockets, D6 H7 reamed blind; same OP as the bottom counterbores

x_beam_section.J_source: Bredt-Batho thin-walled closed-section formula J = 4 Am^2 t / pm (mid-wall), uncertainty about +/-10 % (corner radii, wall tolerance +/-0.2 mm)

vs_4080_tslot_catalogue_typical.note: 4080 open-profile J ~1.2e5 mm^4 is an estimate (rarely catalogued); a 4080 alone would give ~0.5 mm at the tip from beam torsion alone
